mechanism: A {{check}} specialization of the {{p_u_r_e}} framework for a candidate {{subject}}. Evaluate the same subject and evidence snapshot independently through {{parsimony}}, {{novelty}}, {{realizable}}, and {{expansive}}, with each axis isolated from every other axis's verdict and reasoning. Apply the corresponding {{parsimony_criterion}}, {{novelty_criterion}}, {{realizable_criterion}}, or {{expansive_criterion}} to convert each axis finding into its named {{parsimony_status}}, {{novelty_status}}, {{realizable_status}}, or {{expansive_status}}, then return those four results and their conjunctive {{aggregate_status}} to the caller.
invariants: Completeness: Each run returns {{parsimony_status}}, {{novelty_status}}, {{realizable_status}}, and {{expansive_status}}; no axis is skipped after an earlier failure.
Isolation: Every axis evaluates the same unchanged {{subject}} and evidence snapshot in an isolated evaluation context that excludes every other axis's verdict and reasoning.
Criterion Mapping: Each axis status is Verified when its accepted criterion is met, Falsified when that criterion is not met, and Unknown when the available evidence cannot establish either result.
Non-Compensation: {{aggregate_status}} is Verified iff all four axis statuses are Verified; it is Falsified if any is Falsified, and Unknown otherwise.
Determinism: The same {{subject}}, four criteria, evidence snapshot, evaluator state, and seed yield the same five statuses.
Observational: Running the check does not mutate {{subject}}, write remediation debt, or alter caller control flow.
